body:
LATEST PRIORITY CORRECTION — Greg direct to Architect3, 2026-11-01, after the real proxy reproduction:
"ok, skupmy sie na tym
naprawmy ten blad i musimy ruszyc dalej"

Focus now on repairing the reproduced remote-proxy window/position reconciliation defect, using the existing producer reproduction and owner. A stable remote message ID must not become two local rows after the source inserts before the fetched window. Take the existing real-proxy regression through the fix, focused validation, required review and integration. Do not replace that result with isolation or another architecture/status round. Preserve existing useful isolation work; gated control remains OFF and the restart signal remains ASAP under the actual preservation and restart boundaries below. Reuse existing transcript/identity owners and evidence; no alternate history registry, identity changes, silent data loss or live-store patch. The coordinator owns assignment and priority; architects retain their existing diagnostic/design role.

CURRENT GREG DIRECTION — 2026-11-01, direct conversation with Engram::Architect3.

Greg's preceding instruction, still applicable except for the newer focus above:
"1. oczekuje dostarczenia izolacji (samo w sobie nie jest zlym pomyslem)
2. gated control pozostaje OFF
uwazam mechanizm za absolutnie niewiarygodny

ostatni tydzien to ciagla walka z gated control, bledy sa katastroficzne,
naprawa jak sam widzisz po tym bledzie jest ciezka
zespol robi inne rzeczy, blad zostanie nie naprawiony

3. czekam na sygnal restartu ASAP"

CURRENT EFFECT:
- Deliver the existing per-session write isolation as a useful deliverable. It limits the impact of a rejected session; it does not prove removal of the duplicate producer or recovery of Advisor6219. Keep those unresolved outcomes explicitly open with their existing owners.
- Gated control remains OFF. No re-enable, canary or enable request follows from a landing, restart, passed gate or any older approval. The earlier ON/canary history is superseded by this direct instruction.
- Prepare the earliest restart signal ASAP, prioritizing the necessary isolation, validation, installation and actual preservation work over unrelated work. Do not make re-enabling control or finishing unrelated features a prerequisite. Coordinators choose the concrete moment and send Greg "restart now" with the installed build hash and reason; Greg performs the TermAl restart.
- ASAP is not a statement that current RAM is durable or permission to discard it. The running old build executes shutdown. Installing a new binary does not replace its write path. Public API content export is supplementary salvage, not a complete restorable authority/state snapshot; a post-restart diff detects loss rather than preventing it. Resolve the concrete preservation requirement through supported mechanisms and report a real blocker plainly, without another routine approval loop or trial restart.
- User prompts must work independently of gated Evaluate/Begin/grant and old control recovery. The concrete OFF -> cancel retained prompt -> empty queue -> Resume/new explicit Human case is still an existing P0 requirement. Preserve and reconcile earlier exact operations separately; do not invent an unsent receipt, blindly replay an unknown prior delivery, or grant extra tool authority.
- Continue the already authorized critical repair without asking Greg again. Greg previously said: "ok, kontynuj prace bez pytania mnie naprawa jest krytyczna". His "NIE CHCE HOT FIX" rejects a symptom-only claim of complete repair; his newer explicit instruction authorizes delivering isolation while the actual cause and recovery remain open.

OWNERS AND EVIDENCE:
TermAl w-8ec0f56d9976 / Sol-03d4 owns isolation; w-135181fe8685 / Sol-1cee owns the Human/OFF path; Opus3 investigates the actual duplicate producer in15589; Architect2 examines the running-build preservation/recovery contract; Fable2 coordinates and Opus2 integrates. Current evidence and outcomes belong on existing Engram w-ed6addd812bd and corresponding TermAl items, not competing rule supplements. Verify the current stage: shipped, installed, running and observed recovered are distinct.

UNCHANGED BOUNDARIES:
Only Sol or Opus author code. Architects diagnose and decide architecture, not execute operational work. Advisor relays only; if blocked, use an available direct reporting route. Existing repository validation, independent reviews, landing/install conditions, supported store access and Greg's restart act remain in force. Reuse launcher/test-runs and native results; no duplicate runs, extra ceremonies or repeated successful checks for paperwork. One full gate host-wide; report actual admission/latency regressions with lane, time and metric. For a model-at-capacity refusal, Greg's standing instruction is same model, Resume after five minutes.

Earlier ON/OFF/canary chronology and withdrawn interpretations are retained in revisions 1–14 and the work notes. They grant no current enable permission.
